headline: RattanIndia Enterprises changes company secretary and compliance officer
summary: RattanIndia Enterprises Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges about a change in its company secretary and compliance officer. Such routine management updates occur periodically as part of internal corporate governance. The announcement has negligible impact on the company's financial operations. Indian retail investors holding the stock face no direct financial consequence from this administrative transition.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on stock value
